instruction: Place the text 'Document Author' in the footer section on all pages of the active document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to insert the text 'Document Author' in the footer of all pages. The evaluator checks if the footer contains this text (case-insensitive). The custom getter extracts footer text from the DOCX file, and the custom metric verifies the expected text is present.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts footer text from the DOCX file using python-docx library
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('text') as the rules dict is passed directly
Case-insensitive substring matching is appropriate for footer text verification
Postconfig properly saves document with Ctrl+S before verification
Getter only checks first section's footer (section.sections[0]) but instruction requires 'all pages' - may miss multi-section documents with different footers
Error handling is robust - returns empty string on failures allowing graceful metric evaluation
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider iterating through all sections to verify footer text is present in all sections: for section in doc.sections: check each section.footer
Could aggregate footer text from all sections or verify text appears in at least one section's footer consistently
For single-section documents (most common case), current implementation is sufficient
